title: Continue
overview: Rito is having a hard time adjusting when Lala's sisters move in and her attempted seductions leave him perpetually frazzled!

title: Doubt and Dish
overview: Rito learns that Yami still wants to kill him, and now she's an overnight guest in his house! However, it's not all rage and resentment! Momo continually tries to seduce Rito.

title: Each Speculation
overview: Momo is intent on making Project Harem a reality -- and she almost succeeds. Meanwhile, Mea begins to shake things up and prepares to welcome a dark force!

title: True Smile ~The Past, Friends and Smiles~
overview: The vindictive Azenda the Tyrant comes to Earth to provoke Yami. Later, Haruna and Rito have yet an awkward encounter, and Mikan and Yami grow closer.

title: A Man? A Woman? ~Changing Ones~
overview: Rito dodges potential encounters with women -- and all their respective parts! -- but he soon gets a firsthand look at the female anatomy... and not in the good way.

title: Metamorphose ~Changing Times~
overview: Momo teaches Rito about the secrets of the female body and seeks to move Project Harem forward. Meanwhile, Rito learns about Ren and Run.

title: Sisters ~The Invention of Happiness~
overview: Rito is confused by his sudden feelings for Lala; true to fashion, things get awkward quickly! Momo and Mea also discover the true and endearing nature of Lala.

title: Bad Mood ~The Bond of Happiness~
overview: Rito begins to get closer with Momo, which makes Mikan uncomfortable. After Rin helps her during a near collapse while walking home, Mikan can no longer hold her tongue.

title: True Self ~The True Face in the Darkness~
overview: That Lala and her inventions.  One of Lala's crazy contraptions ends up getting Rito and Yami stuck to each other by their hands!

title: Past ~The Memory That Leads to Tomorrow~
overview: The truth needs to come out. Yami finally begins telling Rito about her past, and explains how she came to be.

title: The Right Thing ~What is the Way of Life?~
overview: The Organization is on the move and Yami is the first target! Meanwhile, Lala learns of a new enemy that may be closer than she thinks.

title: Room ~The Maiden's Thought~
overview: Momo takes to playing dating sims to figure out how to get her harem under way. At school, a group of students form a Momo fan club, which ends up keeping her away from Rito.
